QuestInfo.name: [Tracking the Outlaw]
QuestInfo.0: There are reports that a major criminal from space landed in Maple World. If you can track down and capture this criminal, you'll get a huge bounty. It won't be easy to find one person in a world this big, though...
QuestInfo.1: These Clues might be just what you need to track down the criminal. Take them to #b#p9010010##k for her analysis.
QuestInfo.2: You received a bounty for bringing in Wanted Criminal Clues. #b With all these Clues, the criminal's identity will be revealed on #eend of this June#n. Who it could be...?#k \r\n #i3800288##i3800289#

item.0: Hey, I need way more Wanted Criminal Clues than this! To receive the bounty, you need to bring me Wanted Criminal Clues. If you bring me at least 50 I'll give you 1000 Mesos for each one!
